system.description: Your natural determination carries you through tough battles. Once per encounter, as a Reaction, you can ignore one non Force-related effect, Talent, Skill, or ability that exceeds your Will Defense. If you spend a Force Point, you can ignore one Mind-Affecting effect, even if it is the result of a Force Power, Force Technique, or Force Secret.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
